Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the sources and confused the burial location (Berlin-Kreuzberg) with the place of death. Credible sources (e.g., Deutsche Biographie) state Karl Friedrich Otto Westphal died in Kreuzlingen, Canton Thurgau, Switzerland, not Berlin-Kreuzberg.
